') center/cover no-repeat;opacity:.60}
.jeu-fond.couche2{opacity:.28;animation:derive 26s linear infinite}
@keyframes derive{from{transform:translate3d(0,-6%,0)}to{transform:translate3d(0,6%,0)}}
#gc{position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ============================================================
   RESPIRATION — les textes ne touchent plus les bords
   ============================================================ */
.screen .px-4{padding-left:18px;padding-right:18px}
.glass.rounded-2xl{border-radius:18px}
.screen{line-height:1.5}   /* le bas de page est gere par le spacer ci-dessus */
.text-\[10px\],.text-\[11px\]{line-height:1.55!important}
.text-\[12px\],.text-\[13px\]{line-height:1.6!important}
.font-semibold,.font-bold{letter-spacing:.2px}
/* Aucun mot ne deborde de sa carte */
.screen div,.screen span,.screen p,.screen button{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal}
.screen .font-o.font-bold{letter-spacing:1.5px}
/* Listes plus aerees */
.space-y-2\.5>*+*{margin-top:12px!important}
.space-y-3>*+*{margin-top:14px!important}
.space-y-1\.5>*+*{margin-top:8px!important}
.bar{height:7px;border-radius:4px}
.screen button{min-height:36px}
.nav-i{min-height:auto}

/* ===== Barre de bonus : 3 boutons toujours accessibles ===== */
/* Barre de bonus : detachee du bas de l'ecran pour rester atteignable
   au-dessus de la barre de gestes Android et de la safe-area. */
/* Hauteur de la bande des boosts, reprise par le moteur pour interdire au
   vaisseau d'y descendre : sans ca les boutons se retrouvaient pile a
   l'altitude de vol et se declenchaient par accident. */
:root{ --h-boosts:74px; }
#barre-bonus{display:flex;gap:9px;position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  bottom:calc(64px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:22;pointer-events:auto}
.bonus-btn{width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:16px;position:relative;
  background:rgba(10,8,22,.8);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.4);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;
  transition:transform .15s,opacity .2s}
.bonus-btn img{width:26px;height:26px;object-fit:contain}
.bonus-btn .nb{font-size:9px;font-weight:800;color:#14F195;line-height:1}
.bonus-btn.vide{opacity:.3;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.bonus-btn.vide .nb{color:#6b7280}
.bonus-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
.glass[data-off]{opacity:.4}
.bonus-btn.pret{border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.75);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(20,241,149,.35)}

/* ===== Titre de secteur, facon chapitre ===== */
#titre-secteur{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:35;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;pointer-events:none;text-align:center;padding:0 24px}
#titre-secteur .num{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:6px;
  color:#14F195;opacity:0;animation:chapNum .7s ease .1s forwards}
#titre-secteur .nom{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-weight:800;
  font-size:clamp(24px,8vw,40px);letter-spacing:1px;margin-top:8px;color:#fff;
  text-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(153,69,255,.9);opacity:0;
  animation:chapNom .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1) .35s forwards}
#titre-secteur .trait{width:0;height:2px;margin-top:14px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#14F195,transparent);
  animation:chapTrait 1s ease .7s forwards}
#titre-secteur.sortie{animation:chapSortie .7s ease forwards}
@keyframes chapNum{from{opacity:0;letter-spacing:14px}to{opacity:1;letter-spacing:6px}}
@keyframes chapNom{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.94)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes chapTrait{to{width:190px}}
@keyframes chapSortie{to{opacity:0}}

/* ===== Fin cinematique ===== */
#final{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:520;display:none;background:#04040a;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;text-align:center}
#final.on{display:flex}
#final .bloc{max-width:360px}
#final .lig{opacity:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.9;color:#e5e3ee;margin-bottom:14px;
  animation:finLigne 1.5s ease forwards}
#final .fin{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:5px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c4b5fd,#14F195);-webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;color:transparent;opacity:0;animation:finLigne 2s ease forwards}
@keyframes finLigne{to{opacity:1}}

/* ===== Menu pause en jeu ===== */
#btn-pause{position:absolute;top:6px;left:42px;z-index:40;
  height:30px;padding:0 11px;border-radius:10px;
  background:rgba(10,8,22,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  border:1px solid rgba(20,241,149,.45);color:#14F195;
  font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1.5px;
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;line-height:1}
#btn-pause:active{transform:scale(.94)}
#btn-pause b{display:inline-block;width:3px;height:11px;background:#14F195;border-radius:1px}
#btn-pause b+b{margin-left:-2px}
#pause{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:450;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(3,3,10,.9);padding:20px}
#pause.on{display:flex}
#pause .bloc{width:100%;max-width:320px}
#pause .ligne{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 0}
#pause .ligne+.ligne{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}

/* ===== SPLASH : logo, Ken Burns, appel a l'action ===== */
#splash{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:500;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;background:#05050a;overflow:hidden;transition:opacity .5s ease}
#splash.parti{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#splash .fond{position:absolute;left:-8%;right:-8%;top:-8%;height:116%;background:var(--bg-home);background-size:cover;
  background-position:center;animation:kenburns 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes kenburns{from{transform:scale(1) translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.16) translate3d(0,-2%,0)}}
#splash .contenu{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;padding:0 24px}
#splash .titre{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(30px,10vw,54px);
  letter-spacing:2px;line-height:1.05;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c4b5fd 0%,#fff 40%,#14F195 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(153,69,255,.75));
  opacity:0;animation:apparait 1.1s ease .25s forwards}
#splash .sous{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:5px;color:#8b8b9e;margin-top:10px;
  opacity:0;animation:apparait .9s ease .9s forwards}
#splash .cta{position:absolute;bottom:12%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;letter-spacing:3px;color:#14F195;opacity:0;
  animation:apparait .8s ease 1.5s forwards, respire 2.1s ease-in-out 2.3s infinite}
@keyframes apparait{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@keyframes respire{0%,100%{opacity:.45}50%{opacity:1}}

/* ===== Tuto premiere visite ===== */
#tuto{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:520;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  background:rgba(3,3,10,.93);padding:20px}
#tuto.on{display:flex}
#tuto .carte{max-width:340px;width:100%;text-align:center}
#tuto .pict{font-size:52px;margin-bottom:14px}
#tuto .pts{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin:16px 0}
#tuto .pts i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);display:block}
#tuto .pts i.on{background:#14F195;box-shadow:0 0 8px #14F195}

/* ===== Transitions entre ecrans : fade + slide ===== */
.screen.active{animation:entreeEcran .3s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1)}
@keyframes entreeEcran{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.screen.game.active{animation:entreeJeu .32s ease}
@keyframes entreeJeu{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.04)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ===== Poussiere d'etoiles sur l'accueil ===== */
#poussiere{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
#poussiere span{position:absolute;display:block;border-radius:50%;background:#c4b5fd;
  opacity:.5;animation:flotte linear infinite}
@keyframes flotte{from{transform:translate3d(0,110%,0)}to{transform:translate3d(0,-15%,0)}}
#s-home>div{position:relative;z-index:1}

/* ===== Minimal utility set (replaces Tailwind CDN) ===== */
.flex{display:flex}.grid{display:grid}.hidden{display:none}.block{display:block}
.relative{position:relative}.absolute{position:absolute}.fixed{position:fixed}
.inset-0{top:0;right:0;bottom:0;left:0}
.top-0{top:0}.bottom-0{bottom:0}.left-0{left:0}.right-0{right:0}
.left-1\/2{left:50%}.-bottom-5{bottom:-1.25rem}
.z-10{z-index:10}.z-20{z-index:20}
.w-full{width:100%}.h-full{height:100%}.w-6{width:1.5rem}.w-8{width:2rem}.w-10{width:2.5rem}.w-16{width:4rem}
.h-10{height:2.5rem}
.min-w-\[72px\]{min-width:72px}
.max-w-sm{max-width:24rem}.max-w-md{max-width:28rem}.max-h-\[80vh\]{max-height:80vh}
.object-cover{object-fit:cover}.object-contain{object-fit:contain}
.items-center{align-items:center}.items-start{align-items:flex-start}.items-end{align-items:flex-end}
.justify-between{justify-content:space-between}.justify-center{justify-content:center}
.flex-col{flex-direction:column}
.gap-2{gap:.5rem}.gap-2\.5{gap:.625rem}
.grid-cols-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.grid-cols-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.overflow-x-auto{overflow-x:auto}.overflow-y-auto{overflow-y:auto}.overflow-hidden{overflow:hidden}
.px-2{padding-left:.5rem;padding-right:.5rem}.px-2\.5{padding-left:.625rem;padding-right:.625rem}
.px-3{padding-left:.75rem;padding-right:.75rem}.px-3\.5{padding-left:.875rem;padding-right:.875rem}
.px-4{padding-left:1rem;padding-right:1rem}.px-7{padding-left:1.75rem;padding-right:1.75rem}
.py-0\.5{padding-top:.125rem;padding-bottom:.125rem}.py-1{padding-top:.25rem;padding-bottom:.25rem}
.py-1\.5{padding-top:.375rem;padding-bottom:.375rem}.py-2{padding-top:.5rem;padding-bottom:.5rem}
.py-2\.5{padding-top:.625rem;padding-bottom:.625rem}.py-3{padding-top:.75rem;padding-bottom:.75rem}
.py-3\.5{padding-top:.875rem;padding-bottom:.875rem}
.pt-2{padding-top:.5rem}.pt-3{padding-top:.75rem}.pt-4{padding-top:1rem}
.pb-1{padding-bottom:.25rem}.pb-2{padding-bottom:.5rem}.pb-3{padding-bottom:.75rem}.pb-4{padding-bottom:1rem}
.mb-1{margin-bottom:.25rem}.mb-1\.5{margin-bottom:.375rem}.mb-2{margin-bottom:.5rem}
.mb-2\.5{margin-bottom:.625rem}.mb-3{margin-bottom:.75rem}.mb-4{margin-bottom:1rem}
.mt-0\.5{margin-top:.125rem}.mt-1{margin-top:.25rem}.mt-1\.5{margin-top:.375rem}.mt-2{margin-top:.5rem}.mt-3{margin-top:.75rem}
.space-y-1\.5>*+*{margin-top:.375rem}.space-y-2>*+*{margin-top:.5rem}.space-y-2\.5>*+*{margin-top:.625rem}.space-y-3>*+*{margin-top:.75rem}
.text-center{text-align:center}.text-left{text-align:left}.text-right{text-align:right}
.whitespace-nowrap{white-space:nowrap}.leading-snug{line-height:1.375}.leading-relaxed{line-height:1.625}
.font-bold{font-weight:700}.font-semibold{font-weight:600}
.text-\[9px\]{font-size:9px}.text-\[10px\]{font-size:10px}.text-\[11px\]{font-size:11px}.text-\[12px\]{font-size:12px}
.text-xs{font-size:.75rem}.text-sm{font-size:.875rem}.text-lg{font-size:1.125rem}.text-2xl{font-size:1.5rem}.text-3xl{font-size:1.875rem}
.text-\[15px\]{font-size:15px}.text-\[16px\]{font-size:16px}
.text-gray-300{color:#d1d5db}.text-gray-400{color:#9ca3af}.text-gray-500{color:#6b7280}
.text-white{color:#fff}.text-white\/80{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}.text-white\/90{color:rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.text-purple-300{color:#d8b4fe}.text-green-300{color:#86efac}.text-green-400{color:#4ade80}
.text-red-300{color:#fca5a5}.text-black{color:#000}
.bg-black\/40{background:rgba(0,0,0,.4)}.bg-black\/50{background:rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.bg-black\/60{background:rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.bg-gradient-to-br{background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom right,var(--tw-g1,#9945FF),var(--tw-g2,#14F195))}
.bg-gradient-to-r{background-image:linear-gradient(to right,var(--tw-g1,#4ade80),var(--tw-g2,#9945FF))}
.bg-gradient-to-t{background-image:linear-gradient(to top,var(--tw-g1,rgba(0,0,0,.8)),var(--tw-g2,transparent))}
.from-purple-500{--tw-g1:#a855f7}.to-green-400{--tw-g2:#4ade80}
.from-green-400{--tw-g1:#4ade80}.to-purple-500{--tw-g2:#a855f7}
.from-black\/80{--tw-g1:rgba(0,0,0,.8)}.to-transparent{--tw-g2:transparent}
.rounded-lg{border-radius:.5rem}.rounded-xl{border-radius:.75rem}.rounded-2xl{border-radius:1rem}.rounded-3xl{border-radius:1.5rem}.rounded-full{border-radius:9999px}
.border{border:1px solid}.border-l-4{border-left:4px solid}.border-green-400{border-color:#4ade80}.border-green-500\/40{border-color:rgba(34,197,94,.4)}
.ring-2{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px}.ring-green-400{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #4ade80}
.opacity-40{opacity:.4}.opacity-35{opacity:.35}.opacity-100{opacity:1}
.grayscale{filter:grayscale(1)}.drop-shadow{filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5))}.drop-shadow-lg{filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4))}
.backdrop-blur{backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.transform{-webkit-transform:translateX(var(--tx,0)) translateY(var(--ty,0));transform:translateX(var(--tx,0)) translateY(var(--ty,0))}
.-translate-x-1\/2{--tx:-50%}.-translate-y-1\/2{--ty:-50%}
.transition-all{transition:all .3s}.duration-300{transition-duration:.3s}
.animate-pulse{animation:pulse 2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1) infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.55}}
.tracking-wider{letter-spacing:.05em}
.cursor-pointer{cursor:pointer}
.pointer-events-none{pointer-events:none}.pointer-events-auto{pointer-events:auto}
.underline{text-decoration:underline}
.w-full{width:100%}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="toast" class="toast"></div>

<!-- ===== ECRAN DE DEMARRAGE ===== -->
<div id="splash" onclick="quitterSplash()">
  <div class="fond"></div>
  <div class="contenu">
    <div class="titre">SEEKER<br>STRIKE</div>
    <div class="sous">GENESIS PROTOCOL</div>
  </div>
  <div class="cta">APPUYER POUR COMMENCER</div>
</div>

<!-- ===== CHOIX DE LA LANGUE — premiere ouverture uniquement ===== -->
<div id="choix-langue" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Choisir la langue / Choose your language">
  <div class="boite">
    <div class="marque"></div>
    <div class="tt">CHOISIS TA LANGUE</div>
    <div class="tt2">CHOOSE YOUR LANGUAGE</div>
    <button onclick="choisirLangueDepart('fr')" class="lg">
      <b>Fran&ccedil;ais</b><span>Continuer en fran&ccedil;ais</span>
    </button>
    <button onclick="choisirLangueDepart('en')" class="lg">
      <b>English</b><span>Continue in English</span>
    </button>
    <div class="pied">Modifiable &agrave; tout moment dans les r&eacute;glages<br>Changeable anytime in settings</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== TUTO PREMIERE VISITE ===== -->
<div id="tuto">
  <div class="carte glass rounded-3xl p-6">
    <div class="pict" id="tuto-pict">\ud83d\udd79\ufe0f</div>
    <div class="font-o font-bold text-base mb-2" id="tuto-titre">SE D\u00c9PLACER</div>
    <div class="text-[12px] text-gray-300 leading-relaxed" id="tuto-texte">Glisse ton doigt n'importe o\u00f9 sur l'\u00e9cran : le vaisseau te suit dans toutes les directions. Au clavier : ZQSD ou les fl\u00e8ches.</div>
    <div class="pts" id="tuto-pts"></div>
    <button onclick="tutoSuivant()" class="btn w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm" id="tuto-btn">SUIVANT</button>
    <button onclick="fermerTuto()" class="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-3">Passer</button>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="voile-rotation" role="alertdialog" aria-label="Tourne ton telephone / Turn your phone">
  <div class="tel"></div>
  <b>TOURNE TON T&Eacute;L&Eacute;PHONE</b>
  <span>Seeker Strike se joue en mode portrait : le terrain vertical fait tout le gameplay. La partie reprend d&egrave;s que tu reviens.</span>
</div>

<div id="s-home" class="screen active"><div id="poussiere"></div>
  <!-- CODE ORBITAL : quatre zones invisibles aux coins, sens horaire depuis le haut-gauche -->
  <div onclick="coinTape(0)" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:46px;height:46px;z-index:40;opacity:0"></div>
  <div onclick="coinTape(1)" style="position:absolute;top:0;right:0;width:46px;height:46px;z-index:40;opacity:0"></div>
  <div onclick="coinTape(2)" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;width:46px;height:46px;z-index:40;opacity:0"></div>
  <div onclick="coinTape(3)" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:46px;height:46px;z-index:40;opacity:0"></div>
  <div class="px-4 pt-4 pb-2">

    <!-- ===== Bandeau d'identite + soldes ===== -->
    <div class="hero">
      <i class="voile"></i>
      <div class="dedans">
        <div class="marque">
          <div id="logo" class="pastille" title="Seeker Nexus"></div>
          <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">
            <h1>SEEKER STRIKE</h1>
            <div class="ver">GENESIS PROTOCOL v4.4 &bull; <span style="color:#fbbf24">DEVNET</span></div>
          </div>
          <button onclick="show('settings')" aria-label="R&eacute;glages" class="glass w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center" style="flex:none"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#c4b5fd"><path d="M19.14 12.94a7.5 7.5 0 0 0 .05-.94 7.5 7.5 0 0 0-.05-.94l2.03-1.58a.5.5 0 0 0 .12-.64l-1.92-3.32a.5.5 0 0 0-.6-.22l-2.39.96a7.3 7.3 0 0 0-1.62-.94l-.36-2.54a.5.5 0 0 0-.5-.42h-3.84a.5.5 0 0 0-.5.42l-.36 2.54c-.58.24-1.12.56-1.62.94l-2.39-.96a.5.5 0 0 0-.6.22L2.71 8.84a.5.5 0 0 0 .12.64l2.03 1.58c-.04.31-.06.62-.06.94s.02.63.06.94l-2.03 1.58a.5.5 0 0 0-.12.64l1.92 3.32c.13.22.39.3.6.22l2.39-.96c.5.38 1.04.7 1.62.94l.36 2.54c.04.24.25.42.5.42h3.84c.25 0 .46-.18.5-.42l.36-2.54c.58-.24 1.12-.56 1.62-.94l2.39.96c.22.08.47 0 .6-.22l1.92-3.32a.5.5 0 0 0-.12-.64l-2.07-1.58zM12 15.5A3.5 3.5 0 1 1 15.5 12 3.5 3.5 0 0 1 12 15.5z"/></svg></button>
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-bottom:6px"><span id="badge-validateur" class="hidden">&#9889; VALIDATEUR</span></div>
        <button onclick="toggleWallet()" class="glass w-full rounded-xl mb-3" style="padding:9px 12px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:600;text-align:left"><span id="w-status">&#128279; Connecter le wallet</span></button>
        <div class="soldes">
          <div class="solde"><u>SOL &bull; TON WALLET</u><b class="text-purple-300" id="b-sol">0.00</b></div>
          <div class="solde"><u>SKR &bull; TON WALLET</u><b class="text-green-300" id="b-skrtok">0</b></div>
          <div class="solde"><u>GC &bull; CR&Eacute;DITS</u><b class="text-emerald-200" id="b-skr">0</b></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ===== Missions ===== -->
    <div class="sect"><span>MISSIONS</span><i class="lig"></i></div>

    <button onclick="show('map')" class="tuile large vedette w-full">
      <div class="rond"><span id="ico-carte"></span></div>
      <div style="flex:1;min-width:0">
        <b style="color:#14F195">CARTE DE CAMPAGNE</b>
        <small id="home-progression">22 secteurs &bull; 7 boss</small>
      </div>
      <span style="color:#14F195;font-size:16px">&#9656;</span>
    </button>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 mt-2.5">
      <button onclick="lancerInfini()" class="tuile danger">
        <div class="rond">&#9854;&#65039;</div>
        <b>INFINI</b>
        <small id="home-infini">Tiens le plus longtemps</small>
      </button>
      <button onclick="show('multi')" class="tuile">
        <div class="rond"><span id="ico-arena"></span></div>
        <b>ARENA</b>
        <small>D&eacute;fi du jour &amp; coop</small>
      </button>
    </div>

    <!-- ===== Progression ===== -->
    <div class="sect"><span>PROGRESSION</span><i class="lig"></i></div>

    <div class="opt" style="margin-bottom:10px">
      <div class="pict"><span id="ico-streak"></span></div>
      <div class="txt" style="flex:1;min-width:0">
        <b>Connexion quotidienne</b>
        <small><span id="streak">0</span> jour(s) d&rsquo;affil&eacute;e</small>
      </div>

Relan&ccedil;able quand tu veux. Un soutien de 0.001 SOL est inclus &mdash; le gameplay, lui, reste 100% GC.</div>

const LOG = (function(){
  const c = (typeof console!=='undefined') ? console : null;
  const sortie = (c && (c.log||c.warn||c.error)) ? (c.log||c.warn||c.error).bind(c) : function(){};
  const prendre = m => (c && typeof c[m]==='function') ? c[m].bind(c) : sortie;
  return { info:prendre('info'), warn:prendre('warn'), erreur:prendre('error'), log:prendre('log') };
})();

function loadAssets() {
